other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
No age, educational qualification, or income restrictions.
Incentive is applicable only to paid courses; free courses are excluded.
Incentive can be claimed only once per course and its assessment.
For DeepSkilling – Paid Pathway, the subscriber must successfully complete the course and assessment and apply for incentive and assessment reimbursement together.

For DeepSkilling – Free Pathway, the subscriber must enroll in a paid course within 180 days of certification, with the next course fee ≥ ₹1,000; otherwise ₹1,000 is withdrawn and the incentive cannot be claimed.
For Bridge and Foundation courses, the subscriber must successfully complete the course and assessment and apply for incentive and reimbursement together.
A learner can avail the GOI incentive only once for each course category.
benefits_summary: Learners receive incentives up to ₹8,000 for paid DeepSkilling courses and up to ₹3,000 for Bridge and Foundation courses, with a maximum total incentive of ₹12,000 per learner.
